title: The Cloud Bill Is a Design Document: Reading Your Architecture in the Invoice
subtitle: Nobody writes the invoice, which is exactly why it describes the system you are running rather than the one you meant to build.

title: Your CI Runner Said privileged: false. It Was Still Root.
subtitle: CVE-2026-73802 is a CVSS 9.9 in the Gitea runner. The privileged flag was forced off. Everything else the workflow author asked for went straight through.

title: The Future Needs Fewer Agents and More Bureaucracy
subtitle: Supervision trees, approval gates, audit logs, and change registers are not friction on an agentic system. They are the conditions under which you can run one at all.

title: The Same Byte, Billed Three Times
subtitle: AWS data transfer isn't a price, it's a lookup on which boundary the byte crossed — and one of those boundaries sits inside a single availability zone.

title: Idempotency Keys: The Cheapest Insurance in Distributed Systems
subtitle: A timeout can't tell you whether the work happened. An idempotency key makes that stop mattering.

title: Publishing a Hash of Someone's Email Is Publishing Their Email
subtitle: A hash hides a value in proportion to how hard that value is to guess, and an email address is barely a guess at all.
